channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Papo Antagonista: a Lei Rouanet para presídios
item.description: On Papo Antagonista, the proposal by presidential candidate Renan Santos of the Missão party to apply the Rouanet Law in prisons was discussed. Based on the Movimento Brasil Livre's Yellow Book, the idea is to use tax incentives to fund cultural projects within the prison system. The 51-page plan was described as original and creative by the show's participants.

item.title: Lula se reúne com Paes e petistas para fechar palanque no Rio
item.description: Lula met with PT and PSD leaders in Brasília to solidify his electoral slate in Rio de Janeiro, with Eduardo Paes (PSD) as gubernatorial candidate and Benedita da Silva (PT-RJ) running for Senate. The ticket also includes Pedro Paulo (PSD-RJ) and Eduardo Cavalieri (PSD), the current mayor of the capital. The goal is to secure a first-round victory to weaken Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), whose electoral base would then be isolated.

item.title: Eduardo diz que Michelle agiu com imaturidade e não deveria ter postado vídeo com críticas a Flávio
item.description: Former federal deputy Eduardo Bolsonaro criticized former first lady Michelle Bolsonaro for posting a video with criticisms against Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, calling her reaction immature and inappropriate. He argued that publicizing family dissatisfaction undermines the Bolsonaro clan's unity in the political landscape.

item.title: PGR se manifesta contra suspensão de doações públicas com contrapartidas no defeso eleitoral
item.description: Attorney General Paulo Gonet opposed the Novo Party's request to suspend a provision in the 2026 Budget Guidelines Law (LDO) allowing public donations with considerations during the electoral blackout period. He argued the injunction is unwarranted, as donations with burdens are already excluded from electoral restrictions under consolidated TSE jurisprudence, and the provision merely reaffirms existing legal understanding without creating a new loophole for electoral advantage.

item.title: PSDB diz ao STF desconhecer “cota de emendas” para presidência do partido
item.description: The PSDB told Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino that it is unaware of any "parliamentary amendment quota" tied to the party presidency. The statement was made in response to a July 15, 2026, order, amid investigations into potential irregularities in public fund distribution. The party says it is fully cooperating with authorities.

item.title: Zema nega ter convidado Michelle para ser sua vice
item.description: Romeu Zema, pre-candidate for President from the Novo party, denied having invited Michelle Bolsonaro to be his running mate in the 2026 election. He stated he only responded to a journalist's question that mentioned her name, without having directly approached or indicated her.

item.title: Deltan pede que TRE informe a elegibilidade dele antes das eleições
item.description: Former federal deputy Deltan Dallagnol (Novo-PR) filed a Request for Declaration of Eligibility (RDE) with the TRE-PR to obtain an advance ruling on his ability to run in the 2026 elections. His defense argues that the TSE's 2023 cassation of his mandate did not establish automatic ineligibility or an eight-year ban, and that all MPF disciplinary complaints were archived or prescribed. Dallagnol claims the 2023 judgment was based on 'future possibilities' that did not materialize and requests that his eligibility be assessed based on the reality of 2026.

item.title: Ibovespa anda de lado de olho em Oriente Médio, pesquisas eleitorais e balanços de big techs
item.description: The Ibovespa closed slightly down 0,03% at 173,3 thousand points, as investors remained cautious amid Middle East tensions, Brazilian electoral polls, and U.S. big tech earnings. While European and U.S. markets rose, Brazil's market lacked momentum with rising interest rates and the dollar falling to R$ 5,07. Banking stocks such as Banco do Brasil (BBAS3), Bradesco (BBDC4), Santander (SANB11) and Itaú (ITUB4) advanced, led by BBAS3's 3,52% gain.

item.title: Brasil e Coreia do Sul assinarão termos de cooperação durante visita de Lee Jae Myung
item.description: Brazil and South Korea will sign cooperation instruments in trade, technology, and innovation during the Brazil-Korea Business Roundtable in São Paulo on July 28, within the framework of President Lee Jae Myung’s official visit. The event will build on agreements initiated during Lula’s February 2026 mission to Seoul, involving key sectors such as automotive, technology, health, and heavy industry.

item.title: Caso Valdemar: PSDB diz desconhecer ‘cota de emendas’ para dirigentes partidários
item.description: The PSDB denied knowledge of any 'quota of amendments' for party leaders in response to an order from Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino, who requested explanations from 21 parties regarding parliamentary amendment controls. The case stems from a Federal Police investigation into Valdemar Costa Neto, PL party president, after R$119 million in his assets were frozen over suspicions of illicit interference in fund allocation. Valdemar initially admitted influencing amendment destinations but later retracted, claiming the term 'indicates' was merely colloquial.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro pede observadores internacionais nas eleições
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) called for international election observers in the upcoming October elections, repeating claims about the unreliability of Brazil's electronic voting system and linking the debate to his father Jair Bolsonaro's ineligibility, which stemmed from a 2022 meeting with ambassadors. He asserted that voting machines used in Brazil originate from the Venezuelan company Smartmatic, citing alleged CIA reports of vote manipulation in Venezuela's 2010 election, despite the TSE clarifying that Smartmatic does not supply technology for Brazilian electronic voting.

item.title: É falso que OAB autorizou visita de Flávio a Jair Bolsonaro
item.description: It is false that the Brazilian Bar Association (OAB) authorized Senator Flávio Bolsonaro to visit his father, Jair Bolsonaro, who is under house arrest. The claim circulates on social media but lacks factual basis. The OAB has no authority to authorize visits to detainees or individuals under house arrest.

item.title: PDT aprova apoio a Lula, mas mantém candidatura de oposição ao PT em Minas
item.description: The PDT approved national support for Lula's re-election but decided to maintain its own candidacy for the Minas Gerais governorship with former Belo Horizonte mayor Alexandre Kalil, positioning itself in opposition to the PT in the state. The party rejected joining the Lulista ticket in Minas, stating Kalil will run 'against the PT, the PSD and whoever else has a candidate'. The convention to confirm the candidacy is scheduled for March 25 at the Minas Gerais Legislative Assembly.

item.title: Convenção do PSD terá versão de Caiado em IA interagindo com público
item.description: The PSD convention will launch Ronaldo Caiado's presidential candidacy on Sunday (26) with a strong digital component, including an interactive AI version of the former governor engaging with the public. The initiative aims to turn the event into a laboratory for testing new technological tools in the campaign. The goal is to explore the use of artificial intelligence to engage voters and innovate in political communication.

item.title: Crusoé: Ex-prefeito de Salvador será 1º suplente de Wagner na chapa ao Senado
item.description: Senator Jaques Wagner (PT-BA) announced that professor, lawyer and former mayor of Salvador, Edvaldo Brito (PSD), will be his first alternate on the Senate re-election ticket. The confirmation was made during a meeting at the PSD headquarters in Bahia, attended by Governor Jerônimo Rodrigues.

item.title: Valdemar diz que Flávio Bolsonaro não estava preparado para concorrer à Presidência
item.description: The national president of the PL, Valdemar Costa Neto, stated that Senator Flávio Bolsonaro was not prepared to run for President in 2026, despite being chosen by former President Jair Bolsonaro. He noted that Flávio lacked time to build a campaign structure and ruled out Senator Tereza Cristina as a running mate, as she aims to become Senate president. Valdemar said he still seeks an agreement with the PP to support Flávio and held a meeting on Tuesday with the pre-candidate and Senator Rogério Marinho to discuss alliances.

item.title: Lula lidera corrida ao Planalto com 40% e amplia vantagem sobre Flávio, diz pesquisa
item.description: Lula leads the 2026 presidential race with 40% voting intentions, ahead of Flávio Bolsonaro at 33%, according to RealTime BigData. Despite high rejection (48%), he maintains an edge in runoff scenarios, technically tying only with Ronaldo Caiado. Federal government approval stands at 46% versus 50% disapproval, indicating a volatile electorate.

item.title: Cotada para vice de Flávio Bolsonaro, Daniella Marques rebate estereótipos sobre mulheres de direita
item.description: Daniella Marques, former president of Caixa and potential running mate for Flávio Bolsonaro, rejected PT stereotypes that portray right-wing women as submissive, asserting equality before God and advocating policies to expand women's economic autonomy. She denied reports of a plan to distribute free cell phones on a large scale, clarifying that the initiative focuses on improving digital access through data bonuses and limited device provision in specific cases, contingent on financial feasibility.

item.title: Dino dá 15 dias para Camilo Santana responder a queixa de Capitão Wagner
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Flávio Dino has given Senator Camilo Santana 15 days to respond to a criminal complaint filed by former federal deputy Capitão Wagner, who alleges Santana falsely accused him of leading two military mutinies. The complaint stems from a May interview by Santana, whose impact was amplified by coverage from Diário do Nordeste on YouTube. Wagner argues the accusation constitutes disinformation intended to damage his public image.

item.title: Eduardo diz que citou Moraes em processo para conseguir green card
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro stated he had to mention Minister Alexandre de Moraes and his STF case during the U.S. green card application process, claiming it supported his argument for permanent residency. He also referenced the Carla Zambelli case in Italy as part of his justification, though experts note the green card does not shield him from a potential extradition request by Brazil.

item.title: Eduardo Bolsonaro diz que Michelle jamais poderia ter feito vídeo contra Flávio: ‘Foi imaturidade’
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro criticized Michelle Bolsonaro for publishing a video accusing her stepson Flávio of disrespect and humiliation, calling her action 'immaturity'. He said such internal divisions are natural given the rivalry for the presidency and that Michelle, if she enters politics, will be held accountable like any other politician.

item.title: Michelle jamais poderia ter feito aquele vídeo, foi imaturidade, diz Eduardo Bolsonaro
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro criticized former first lady Michelle Bolsonaro for a video in which she claimed to have been disrespected by her stepson, Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, calling her behavior immature. The video was posted on social media at the end of June.

item.title: Valdemar Costa Neto diz que Flávio Bolsonaro não estava preparado para ser candidato
item.description: Valdemar Costa Neto, national president of the PL, stated that the party's presidential pre-candidate, Flávio Bolsonaro, was not prepared to run, citing lack of structure and prior work. He also said the choice of running mate will be made by Jair Bolsonaro, currently under house arrest, and that he does not rule out reconciling with Michelle Bolsonaro to strengthen the campaign.

item.title: Lula tem 70,8%, e Flávio, 22,2%, em 2º turno no PI, diz pesquisa
item.description: An AtlasIntel/Meio Norte poll conducted from July 15 to 20, 2026, in Piauí shows President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) leading with 70.8% voting intention in a second-round scenario against Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), who has 22.2%. In the first-round scenario, Lula has 66.7%, followed by Flávio with 18.1% and Renan Santos (Missão) with 3.1%. Approval of Lula’s government in the state stands at 66.5%, with 59% rating it as excellent or good.

item.title: Eduardo chama Michelle de "imatura" e diz que madrasta "jamais" poderia ter gravado vídeo contra Flávio
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro criticized Michelle Bolsonaro for releasing a video accusing Flávio Bolsonaro of mistreating her, calling the move 'immature' and arguing that family disputes should be resolved privately. He downplayed the political impact of the episode on Flávio's presidential pre-campaign, attributing any polling fluctuations to the Dark Horse film case involving banker Daniel Vorcaro, not the conflict with Michelle.

item.title: Em reunião com embaixadores, Flávio Bolsonaro pede observadores para eleições de outubro
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro urged foreign ambassadors to send as many election observers as possible to Brazil’s October elections, citing concerns over the Venezuelan origin of some voting technology and referencing a CIA document alleging manipulation in Venezuela’s 2010 elections. He also supported continued use of fossil fuels and claimed his father, Jair Bolsonaro, became ineligible after meeting with diplomats.

item.title: PF recomenda demissão de Eduardo Bolsonaro por abandono de cargo após fuga aos EUA
item.description: The Federal Police recommended the dismissal of Eduardo Bolsonaro for abandonment of duty after his flight to the United States in February 2023. The decision now rests with Justice Minister Wellington Lima e Silva. Eduardo was previously convicted by the Supreme Court for coercion in the course of justice and obstruction, receiving a sentence of four years and two months in prison, a fine, and eight years of ineligibility.

item.title: Judiciário não substitui a política, mas deve atuar sem submissão aos Poderes, diz Fachin
item.description: Supreme Court President Edson Fachin stated that the judiciary does not replace politics but must exercise its functions without undue submission to the Executive and Legislative branches, and without yielding to economic interests, media campaigns, or popular and internal pressures. He emphasized judicial autonomy as essential to the rule of law.

item.title: PF conclui pela demissão de Eduardo Bolsonaro
item.description: The Federal Police concluded an administrative disciplinary process against Eduardo Bolsonaro recommending his dismissal for abandonment of duty, after he remained in the U.S. without returning to work despite his mandate being revoked in December 2025. The Justice Minister will make the final decision on his dismissal, while Bolsonaro also faces a STF conviction for attempting to interfere in the coup plot trial and recently received a U.S. green card.

item.title: PF apreende carros de luxo do ‘Careca do INSS’ na Operação Sem Desconto
item.description: The Federal Police executed a search and seizure warrant against lobbyist Antonio Camilo Antunes, known as 'Careca do INSS', in Operation Sem Desconto, following an order from Supreme Court Justice André Mendonça. The operation targets the seizure of three luxury vehicles linked to a fraud scheme in the INSS that may have moved up to R$ 6 billion, involving illegal discounts on pensions and retirement benefits. Antunes, former INSS president Alessandro Stefanutto, and 46 others were indicted for forming a criminal organization, money laundering, and passive corruption.

item.title: Sem citar Eduardo Bolsonaro, Caiado diz que quem precisa de green card é ‘produtor brasileiro’
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado stated that Brazilian producers need a green card to access the U.S. market without paying tolls, criticizing U.S. tariffs on Brazilian goods. He emphasized strengthening agribusiness, industry, and job protection, framing it as a matter of moral authority to govern, not tourism. The comment came amid escalating diplomatic tensions after the U.S. imposed a 25% tariff on Brazilian exports.

item.title: Valdemar Costa Neto diz que acordo com Tereza Cristina para vice de Flávio Bolsonaro não avançou
item.description: PL president Valdemar Costa Neto said no agreement was reached for Senator Tereza Cristina to be Flávio Bolsonaro's running mate in 2026, as she intends to run for Senate Presidency. He stated the final decision will rest with Jair Bolsonaro and mentioned other potential female candidates like Daniella Marques and Simone Marquetto, emphasizing the party's strategy to appeal to women voters and build alliances with PP, União Brasil, Republicanos, Podemos, and PSDB.

item.title: Plano de governo de Renan Santos promete extinguir favelas, sistema de cotas e modelo atual do Bolsa Família
item.description: Renan Santos, the presidential pre-candidate from the Missão party (linked to MBL), unveiled the 'Yellow Book', promising to 'defavelize' Brazil in 10 years, abolish racial quotas in education, and replace Bolsa Família with 'paid work fronts'. The plan includes declaring a state of defense and GLO in areas controlled by criminal factions, inspired by El Salvador’s model, proposing measures such as reversal of the burden of proof, super-prisons, and federalization of organized crime cases, contingent on congressional approval.

item.title: Apesar do apoio nacional, PDT vai enfrentar o PT em Minas com Kalil
item.description: Despite the national alliance between PDT and PT, in Minas Gerais the parties will maintain separate candidacies for the state government. The PDT supports Alexandre Kalil’s pre-candidacy, who appears in second place in polls with 14%, while the PT officially nominated Patrus Ananias, who has not yet appeared in polls. The PDT’s state leadership argues that Kalil has stronger electoral performance and that backing Patrus would mean abandoning a competitive position.

item.title: Crusoé: “Green Card quem precisa é o produtor brasileiro”, diz Caiado
item.description: Former Goiás governor and presidential pre-candidate Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) criticized former deputy Eduardo Bolsonaro (PL) for receiving a U.S. green card, arguing that what Brazil needs is access to the American market for its producers — without having to pay extra costs or face barriers.

item.title: Sargento preso por morte de capitã já atuou na segurança de Zema
item.description: Sergeant Eduardo Abner Pereira de Oliveira, suspected of killing Captain Michele Leão Azevedo of the PMMG, was arrested after bringing her body to the hospital, claiming she fell down the stairs. He previously worked in the security detail for Governor Romeu Zema and was removed from ASPRA/PMBM due to disciplinary issues. The Civil Police are investigating the case as homicide, with evidence of bodily injuries and ecstasy use.

item.title: Entenda a proposta do setor de máquinas para conter impacto do tarifaço
item.description: Abimaq presented to the Lula government a package of measures to mitigate the effects of the 25% U.S. tariff on Brazilian products, including the reinstatement of Reintegra, pre-export credit lines, federal tax deferrals, expanded ApexBrasil actions, and adjustments to the Brazil Soberano program. The proposals aim to reduce the 'Brazil cost,' increase competitiveness, and diversify export markets.

item.title: Brasil tem 918,9 mil eleitores no exterior; veja onde eles estão
item.description: The number of Brazilian voters abroad eligible to vote in the 2026 elections reached 918,900, a 31.8% increase over four years. The largest voting posts are in Lisbon (Portugal), Boston (USA), and Porto (Portugal), with the U.S. having the highest number of eligible voters (265,000), followed by Portugal (134,000) and Japan (88,300). Despite this historical growth, abstention among overseas voters remains high, with 51% not voting in past elections.

item.title: PL adia convenção em Minas e cogita realizar encontro sem definir candidato ao governo, prolongando o impasse de Flávio no estado
item.description: The PL postponed its Minas Gerais convention to July 27 without yet defining a gubernatorial candidate, prioritizing efforts to persuade Senator Cleitinho (Republicanos) to run for governor. The decision considers Cleitinho’s personal mourning after his brother’s death and his current unwillingness to engage in politics, with the party considering approving only proportional candidacies at the convention and delaying the majoritarian ticket until the August 5 deadline. This uncertainty complicates Flávio Bolsonaro’s presidential campaign, as Minas Gerais is the country’s second-largest electoral college.

item.title: Valdemar diz que Trump “perdeu um pouco o rumo” ao taxar Brasil
item.description: Valdemar Costa Neto, president of the PL party, criticized Donald Trump's decision to include Brazil in the U.S. tariff package, calling it 'madness' and stating that Trump 'lost his way'. He advocated for diplomatic negotiation to reverse the tariffs, citing Flávio Bolsonaro's recent U.S. visit as evidence of inconsistent U.S. policy.

item.title: Zema nega convite para Michelle Bolsonaro ser vice após atrito gerado com a cúpula do PL
item.description: Romeu Zema (Novo) denied having made any formal invitation to Michelle Bolsonaro (PL) to be his running mate in 2026, stating he only mentioned her name as a possibility in response to a journalist's question. Michelle had already publicly ruled out the idea, noting she has not yet decided whether to run for Senate and that, as a PL member, she cannot run on a separate ticket from her party, which has already nominated Flávio Bolsonaro as its presidential candidate. Zema’s comment provoked irritation within the PL leadership, which viewed it as an attempt to exploit internal divisions within the Bolsonarist movement to boost his own candidacy.

item.title: Nova pesquisa mostra disputa voto a voto entre Lula e Flávio na região mais populosa do país
item.description: The Real Time Big Data poll shows Lula leading in the Northeast with 54% voting intentions, while Flávio Bolsonaro leads in the South with 41%. In the Southeast, the country's most populous region, both candidates are tied at 37%, indicating a vote-by-vote race. Other candidates like Renan Santos (12%) and Ronaldo Caiado (7%) also show strong performance in the Southeast.

item.title: Candidatos à Presidência poderão gastar até R$ 133,4 milhões na campanha de 2026, decide TSE
item.description: The TSE has set the campaign spending limit for the 2026 presidential race at R$133.4 million, as officially published in a regulation on Tuesday (21). The cap applies to all candidates running for President of the Republic in the October 2026 elections.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro reforça queixa-crime contra Janones no STF
item.description: The defense of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro filed a supplement to a criminal complaint against federal deputy André Janones at the Supreme Court, claiming Janones' recent statements confirm a 'deliberate and illicit strategy' of insults, including calling Bolsonaro a 'bandit', 'thief', and 'militiaman'. Janones said he will continue using such terms and declared his goal is the 'annihilation and complete extermination of Bolsonarism'. The defense argues the remarks exceed free speech protections and are not legitimate political criticism.

item.title: O plano de governo de Renan Santos
item.description: The Mission Party, founded by the Free Brazil Movement (MBL), unveiled a government plan for Renan Santos’ pre-candidacy to the Presidency, proposing a deep reform of the Brazilian state, including cutting approximately 70% of the country’s municipalities. The text only describes the plan’s content, without further details on other proposals or political context.

item.title: Bolsonaro é quem decidirá vice de Flávio, diz presidente do PL
item.description: PL party president Valdemar Costa Neto stated that former President Jair Bolsonaro will decide the vice-presidential candidate on the ticket of his eldest son, Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), for the 2026 elections. The comment was made in a Reuters interview on Tuesday, underscoring Bolsonaro’s central role in shaping the party’s electoral strategy.

item.title: Oposição resgata fala de 2021 em que Lula compara Ortega a Merkel
item.description: Brazilian opposition revived a 2021 video in which Lula compares Daniel Ortega's prolonged rule in Nicaragua to that of leaders like Angela Merkel and Felipe González, advocating for power alternation while stating he cannot interfere in other nations' sovereign decisions. He added that if Ortega imprisoned opposition figures to prevent electoral competition, such action would be 'totally wrong'.

item.title: PF encerra processo e decide demitir Eduardo Bolsonaro por abandono de cargo
item.description: The Federal Police concluded the administrative disciplinary process against Eduardo Bolsonaro and decided on his dismissal for abandonment of duty. The former deputy has lived in the U.S. since February 2025 as a political exile, having lost his mandate in December 2024 due to unjustified absences. He was sentenced by the STF to four years and two months in prison for coercion against the Judiciary.

item.title: Real Time Big Data: candidato mais competitivo contra Lula no 2º turno não é Flávio
item.description: According to the Real Time Big Data survey, former Goiás governor Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) is the only adversary of Lula who numerically leads in the second-round simulation, with 44% versus Lula’s 43%, though within the margin of error, resulting in a technical tie. Caiado demonstrates the highest competitiveness among tested opponents, outperforming Flávio Bolsonaro, Renan Santos and others, despite having only 7% in the first round. Other scenarios show Lula ahead, but the Caiado matchup is the most competitive.

item.title: Acordo com Tereza Cristina (PP) para vice de Flávio Bolsonaro não avançou, afirma Valdemar
item.description: PL president Valdemar Costa Neto stated that no agreement could be reached for Senator Tereza Cristina (PP-MS) to be the vice-presidential candidate on Flávio Bolsonaro’s (PL-RJ) ticket for the 2026 elections.
